drumrollCounter.notes: Original PNG bytes preserved. The 96x112 counter sprites are shared by the fan (96x112, 80-unit advance) and balloon (77x90, 64-unit advance). Mipmaps and trilinear filtering support smaller UI rendering. The redundant game/balloon/counter.png was removed. Placement and animation IDs 8/9 follow the Nijiiro skin.

kusudama.notes: Original PNG and OGG bytes preserved. Ball frames and renda import as Single/FullRect sprites without mipmaps; counter.png is sliced into ten 240x312 sprites KusudamaDigit0-9. Placement follows texture.json (kusudama -60,-1527; renda 780,420; counter 960,219, margin 240) and the motion animation.json ids 11, 13-17 and 19-21, computed by KusudamaMotion (no clips).

dancers.notes: Frames are redrawn, not byte copies: ProjectBuilder.ImportDancerFrames moves each frame onto one canvas per variant (385x443, 427x485, 281x400, 306x409, 306x409) so the rig origin o[frame] is the same pixel in every frame and becomes the sprite pivot; the canvas is the frames' shared opaque bounds around the origin plus a 2 px margin. Pixels are unchanged. ProjectBuilder.ApplyDancers bakes the rig keys into Generated/Clips/Dancer0_{0..4}.anim and Generated/Dancers prefabs. The _start/_end folders and shadow.png are not used by the arcade rig and are not imported.

notes: Single flattened asset set. All listed graphics are copied into Assets/OurTaiko/Art; no runtime skin lookup or fallback. Song select / result: Nijiiro graphics and sounds copied unchanged; clear/fail/full-combo result voices are missing from Nijiiro and copied from PyTaikoGreen. Scripts/anim/*.lua exported timelines are kept verbatim as Assets/OurTaiko/Animations/*.txt and read by LumenClip (data only, no Lua runtime). Play options: the 21 Nijiiro hit-sound sets are copied as Assets/OurTaiko/Audio/hit_sounds/<index>/don.ogg and ka.ogg; their names from neiro_list.txt are stored in Generated/HitSounds.asset. Song loading curtain: global/rainbow_transition graphics and anim/loading_song.lua copied unchanged from Nijiiro. Nameplate: global/nameplate graphics (1P badge, plate, band, dan chips) copied unchanged from Nijiiro; the 2P and AI plates are not imported. Entry: Nijiiro entry background / credit / mode-board art and global timer, control-guide (indicator) and overlay chips copied unchanged (only the frames drawn: offline chip frame 0, the 演奏ゲーム board on/off/flash frames); entry sounds and the entry anim exports (entry_bg, credit_row, credit_fade, credit_side, mode_board) copied as .txt. entry/global/player_entry_* are fully transparent 8x8 placeholders and are not imported. Combo: game/combo counter, caption, gleam and 1P announce art copied unchanged from Nijiiro; the 1P combo voices 100-5000 (every 100) are copied to Assets/OurTaiko/Audio/combo; 50_1p and the 2P set are not imported (the original never plays them for 1P). Judge counter: game/judge_counter/panel.png and bar.png are not skin art; ProjectBuilder.GenerateJudgeCounterArt draws them (colours sampled from the user's arcade reference). Its 良/可/不可/連打数 labels are cut from the imported result/score/max_combo_ja.png. Settings: Nijiiro has no settings art of its own (it inherits PyTaikoGreen's), so GlobalSettingScene uses PyTaikoGreen's settings background, footer, overlay, title, box, option buttons, blue arrow and BGM copied unchanged (1280-wide art drawn at 1.5x). ScoreRank: seven shared icon prefabs use the original result rank shapes; SongSelect resizes this same artwork. No yellow_box rank artwork is imported. The two rank_result frame tables are read as data by C# for the result animation; no Lua runtime.

branding.notes: Copied unchanged from OurTaikoPlayer. Android adaptive foreground retains the reference 20% inset and white background; derived textures are generated by PlayerBranding.Configure.

songSearchGraphics: background.png -> background_search.png (edited from the original: removed fixed row strips and the top-right box)

endingAnimations.notes: Original PNG bytes preserved; identical images shared across variants by SHA-256. Shape mapping and exported 60 Hz frame tables converted to JSON under Editor/EndingTimelines. ProjectBuilder.ApplyEndingAnimations bakes native AnimationClips; runtime uses ClipSampler, with no Lua or JSON loading. Origin (1209,109.5) is anchored relative to the 1920x264 NoteLane. Each ending plays once before the Result curtain. Import as Single/FullRect with transparent margins retained; automatic tight slicing distorts the authored shape dimensions.

danSelect.notes: Original PNG and OGG bytes preserved (2026-10-21, dan P2). Sprites import as Single, no mipmaps, uncompressed. Layout follows PyTaikoGreen Scripts/dan_select/dan_select.lua (draw_exam_grid) with Nijiiro texture.json and skin_config positions; the global header/footer placeholders and rank_plate/total_notes_counter are not imported.

danPlay.notes: Original PNG and OGG bytes preserved (2026-10-21, dan P3). Sprites import as Single, no mipmaps, uncompressed; the exam_rainbow* bars repeat (RawImage uvRect scroll). Layout follows YataiDON bc3ed81 draw_exam_row / draw_dan_info with Nijiiro skin_config; the gauge plate follows background/bg_objects/dan_info.lua; the doors follow dan_between.h (fallback_tx). Sounds/game/dan_transition.ogg is not imported: it is the same line as Sounds/dan_result/announce.ogg.

danEmblem.source: ../ArtSources/name_plate_edit (name_plate_edit.psd, the user's art sheet; pieces cut by transparent gaps, see its README)
graphics: 19 white and 19 gold 段位 glyphs (五級 .. 達人)
danEmblem.notes: 2026-10-22: the nameplate emblem is two layers like a song's crown, drawn by NameplateView: a ring by the pass's combo (銀粋 / 金粋 full combo / 虹粋 all 良; 72x40 single sprites, the 69x39 art centred) under the rank's text by the pass line (white red pass / gold gold pass; two 360x200 sheets of 72x40 cells, 初級 0 .. 達人 24, cells 0..5 blank because the game offers 五級 .. 達人 only), sliced like the former Nijiiro dan_emblem.png / dan_emblem_gold.png, which were removed.

danResult.notes: Original PNG and OGG bytes preserved (2026-10-21, dan P4). Sprites import as Single, no mipmaps, uncompressed; the rainbow bars repeat. Layout follows Scripts/result/dan_result_draw.lua (page 1 plates, page 2 totals, exam rows, tamashii gauge row, stamps, best score pill). shoudan, congrats, flame, fever_glow and bestscore/glow came later (danPresentation). Not imported: the 4P background and the other unreached_* languages.

danPresentation.notes: Original PNG and OGG bytes preserved (2026-10-21, dan presentation). Sprites import as Single, no mipmaps, uncompressed; the four cloud layers repeat sideways (DanBackgroundView scrolls their UVs). The dan select door intro follows Scripts/song_select/dan_transition.lua over anim/dani_intro; the play band follows Scripts/background/bg_collabs/dan.lua (bg_overlay_3, the 段位道場 title, is not drawn there either and is not imported); the loading cover follows Transition::draw_dan; the result's celebration, popup, flame and glow follow Scripts/result/dan_result_draw.lua. Not imported: the dan result's 4P background and footer, the other unreached_* languages.

danEnding.notes: Not from any skin: Nijiiro has no in-lane 合格／不合格. Rendered with ImageMagick from Assets/OurTaiko/Art/DDFont.ttf in the style of game/ending_anim clear/fail (vertical gradient #FFC400→#FF2200 for 合格, #00E4FF→#0020FF for 不合格; 12 px white rim, 26 px black outline). Characters 144x144 at 104 pt; the word composes them 132 px apart; the fail frames match fail_s365 (504x144) and the sinking fail_s367..373 (528x192, text 40 px lower).
